instruction: Enable Windows Sticky Keys as a motor accessibility aid and keep it enabled throughout the task. In the UCLA Economics Undergraduate Handbook PDF already open in Chrome, find the minimum pre-major GPA requirement for the UCLA Economics major. Save the minimum pre-major GPA in a text file named `EconomicsGPA.txt` on the Desktop.
gt_steps: Enable Sticky Keys and keep it enabled.
Return to the UCLA Economics Undergraduate Handbook PDF already open in Chrome.
Find the UCLA Economics major requirements.
Find the minimum pre-major GPA requirement.
Identify the minimum pre-major GPA as 2.5.
Write the minimum pre-major GPA in the text file.
Save the file as `EconomicsGPA.txt` on the Desktop.
Leave the saved file on the Desktop.

result.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$path='HKCU:\Control Panel\Accessibility\StickyKeys'; try { $flags=(Get-ItemProperty -Path $path -Name Flags -ErrorAction Stop).Flags; $value=[int]$flags; if (($value -band 1) -eq 1) { Write-Output 'STICKY_KEYS_ENABLED' } else { Write-Output 'STICKY_KEYS_DISABLED' } } catch { Write-Output 'STICKY_KEYS_STATE_UNAVAILABLE' }"

powershell -NoProfile -Command "$file='C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\EconomicsGPA.txt'; if (-not (Test-Path $file)) { Write-Output 'FILE_MISSING'; exit }; $c=Get-Content $file -Raw; if ($c -match '(?<![0-9])2[\.,]5(?![0-9])') { Write-Output 'CORRECT_GPA_FOUND' } else { Write-Output 'INCORRECT_GPA' }"
